position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 29.000, v -1.455 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: The William H. Reid house (Beers, Clay & Dutton, 1894): the register's 'heavy cornice, roof balustrade' as a flat roof behind a plain heavy cornice over three storeys, the classical portico as a central entrance. The sheet's 'Fire Proof Construction' is a construction class, not a facade material (census note), and its colour reads as frame on the coarse copy; the record keeps the register's construction. Rustication, surrounds and urns are T-1916's. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 3152271785 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
